newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Rung Reung Finance plans debenture issue.
newsitem.headline: Thai Rung Reung Finance plans debenture issue.

text.p: Thai Rung Reung Finance and Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday it planned to issue 1.5 billion baht ($60 million) in unsecured debentures and had appointed Union Asia Finance as its lead underwriter.
The debentures would be issued in two tranches of 1.0 billion and 500 million baht respectively through private placement, Thai Rung Reung said in a statement.
Coupon rates for the debentures will be fixed during the book building process, the company said.
Thai Rung Reung will used the funds to expand its credit base and to raise long-term debts, it said.
Thai Rung Reung posted a net profit of 100 million baht in the first six months this year compared with 74.4 million in the same period last year.
In 1995, its net profit was 159.94 million baht against 138.56 million in the previous year, it said.
